objective: Derive the tightest number and proportion bounds for members attending either workshop, construct feasible endpoint allocations and explain what membership evidence would establish an exact value.

sources.text: A fictional drawing society has 60 registered members. Its roster was unchanged during both workshops; both were open only to those registered members.
The charcoal workshop recorded 42 distinct members and the ink workshop recorded 27 distinct members. Each attendance list counts each member once. Members were allowed to attend both workshops.
The two lists have not been matched and the number attending both workshops was not recorded. The requested proportion concerns registered members, excluding visitors viewing the public exhibition.
